name: Eclipse Papyrus
description: An extensible Eclipse-based modeling environment for UML 2.5 and SysML 1.6, with satellite capabilities such as code generation.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 前身为TOPCASED。Eclipse的UML插件，随Eclipse升级。致力于关键系统的建模。支持UML2.5、SysML 1.6（目前尚不支持v2），可自行添加图形，代码生成器。
